text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali on Wednesday urged improvement of the quality of Tunisian-made products to boost exports.
- The 7th Mediterranean Conference of the Red Cross and Red Crescent on Wednesday awarded a gold medal to President Ben Ali for his support to their humanitarian action.

- Prime Minister Hamed Karoui on Tuesday held talks with the Dutch foreign minister and European council of miniters' chairman, Hans Van Mierlo, on Euro-Mediterranean conference to be held in Malta on April 15-16.
- Golf is becoming a strong asset for Tunisian tourism in the northern region of Tabarka.
- President Ben Ali on Wednesday chaired a cabinet meeting devoted to discussion of several economic issues.
- Rainfalls in the north and the eastern coastal region of Sahel came at the right time to reduce the water shortage this season.
- Exports rose by 13 percent during the first two months of 1997.
- Industry Minister Slaheddine Bouguerra says that textiles represent 54 percent of Tunisian exports.
